messages:
Priya: FYI - the nightly invoice export to NetSuite is failing for ~18 invoices. NetSuite reports CUSTOMER_NOT_FOUND. I dug into the payloads and noticed our CSV exporter truncated Stripe customer IDs to 12 chars.

billing-bot: nightly-export-job failed: 04:00 UTC - netsuite_api 404 "CUSTOMER_NOT_FOUND" (export id: ne-2026-03-24-04)

Priya: Example from the export vs Stripe: 

Export CSV row: customer_ref=cus_9bXabCde01
Stripe payload: customer.id=cus_9bXabCde01234xyz

So NetSuite gets cus_9bXabCde01 which doesn't match any customer record, causing orphan invoice attempts.

Elena: Oof. I ran a quick grep in the exporter repo and found this line in csv_writer: `fmt.Sprintf("%s", id[:12])` - looks like someone added truncation during a prior compliance change and forgot to revert.

Raj: That would explain the pattern. When we create NetSuite records we use full external id mapping, so the truncated id fails lookup and the downstream upsert ends up creating a placeholder or failing.

Sam: Can we just patch csv_writer to emit the full id and re-run the nightly export? Any risk of duplicates if we re-emit full ids?

Elena: Patch ready in a branch. Two things to consider: 1) some invoices were already created in NetSuite with a different customer_ref (placeholder), 2) re-emitting will create/update correctly for the rest. We should disable the nightly job first to avoid more bad rows.

Priya: I've put the nightly-export job on hold (job 04:00). Created TICKET-4310: "Truncated customer_ref in nightly NetSuite export -> orphaned invoices". Finance flagged collections hold for the 18 impacted invoices.

billing-bot: quarantine-queue: 18 messages moved to export-fix-quarantine-2026-03-24.

Raj: For remediation plan: 
1) Hotfix csv_writer to stop truncation and add regression test for IDs > 12 chars.
2) Run a mapping job that pairs truncated_ref -> full_stripe_id for records where NetSuite created placeholder customers; generate a reconciliation plan (update external id on NS or merge).
3) Re-run export for quarantined invoices with full ids.
4) Finance to review any invoices that were created against placeholder customers for potential reversal/merge.

Priya: Finance action: I'll review the 18 invoices list and put a hold on dunning and collections. If merges are needed, we might need NetSuite admin privileges - @Sam can you coordinate?

Sam: Will coordinate with our Netsuite admin. Also suggest we add an e2e test: create invoice in staging with long stripe id and ensure export lookup succeeds.

Elena: Deployed hotfix to canary cluster (exporter v2.1.3-canary). Added unit test and updated csv_writer to use full id. No truncation now.

billing-bot: exporter-canary metrics: 100% success for 50 sample exports in canary region.

Raj: After canary verification, I'll run the mapping backfill script to reconcile placeholder customers (dry-run first). ETA for dry-run: 2 hours. Full backfill after sign-off.

Priya: Good. Please attach the dry-run output to TICKET-4310. Finance will review and sign off on the merge policy. If any invoices need manual credit memos or reversals, we'll handle top-5 manually today.

ops-bot: scheduled-job disabled: nightly-export-job (id: ne-2026-03-24-04) by Priya.

Elena: Follow-ups: 1) add a lint check to prevent slicing of ids anywhere in exporter libraries, 2) add a small schema check on export rows so a customer_ref shorter than 16 chars triggers an alert, 3) include Stripe id parity test in nightly CI.

Sam: Noted. Also let's update runbook: if netsuite return 404 CUSTOMER_NOT_FOUND on export, quarantine and notify finance immediately.

Priya: Thanks everyone. I'll update TICKET-4310 with finance decisions and mark top-5 for manual handling. If anyone sees customer support pings about missing invoices, escalate to me.

Raj: Dry-run attached to ticket in ~2h. Postmortem scheduled for tomorrow morning to walk root cause and rollout checklist. :white_check_mark:
